verses.text: Ix elxi winhaj David chi' ta', ix b'at sk'ub'anel sb'a winh t'a jun k'een nhak'een t'a yol yik Adulam. Ayik ix yab'an heb' winh yuk'tak winh yet' heb' sk'ab' yok winh b'aj ayek' winh, ix b'at heb' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'a yet' winh.
Ix k'ochpax heb' tz'ixtaxi, masanil heb' ay sb'ok yet' heb' ay schab'k'olal. Ha winhaj David chi' ix och yajalilok heb'. Ay am junok 400 heb' winh winak t'a smasanil.

Spetoj winhaj David t'a Adulam chi', ix k'ochkan winh t'a Mizpa, t'a yol yik Moab. Ix yalan winh t'a winh sreyal Moab chi' icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to skan winh in mam yet' ix in nun het'ok masanto ol wil tas ol in yutej Dios, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'anb'at smam snun winh chi' t'a yichanh winh sreyal Moab chi'. Ha yet' winh ix aj heb' yakb'an ayek' winhaj David chi' skol sb'a t'a jolomtak witz.

Haxo winhaj Gad, schekab' Dios ix halan t'a winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Manh ach kan t'a tik yuj a kolan a b'a, palta meltzajanh t'a yol yik Judá, xchi winh. Icha chi' ix aj sb'at winhaj David, masanto ix k'och winh t'a jun kaltak te' t'a yol yik Haret.

Ay jun k'ual, k'ojanem winhaj Saúl t'a yich jun te' tamarisko t'a jolom witz t'a Gabaa, lak'b'ilk'e k'een slanza winh yuj, oyanoch heb' yajalil soldado t'a spatik winh. Hata' ix yab' winh to ix cheklaj b'aj ayek' winhaj David yet' heb' soldado.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' soldado oyanoch t'a spatik chi': --Ex wetchonhab' yinhtilal Benjamín, ab'ek tas ol wala': ¿Tom tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool to a winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' ol ak'an he lu'um yet' te' eyuwa? ¿Tom he masanil ol ex och t'a komandanteal yet' t'a kapitanil yuj winh?

Yuj chi' he masanilxonhej a ex ayex ek' tik tzex och ajk'olal t'ayin. Malaj mach tz'alan t'ayin, tato a winh wuninal toxo ix yak' strato winh yet' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi'. Malaj junok ex ayex ek' tik tzex och jab'ok ilk'olal wuuj. Malaj junok ex tzeyal t'ayin tato toxo ix och winh wuninal chi' yak'an sk'ol jun in chekab', yik tz'och ajk'olal t'ayin in smilan icha sk'ulej tiknaik, xchi winhaj Saúl chi'.

Aypaxoch winhaj Doeg aj Edom t'a skal heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi', yuj chi' ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Ix wil winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi' ayik ix b'atkan winh t'a Nob, ix k'och winh t'a winhaj Ahimelec yuninal winhaj Ahitob.
Ha winhaj Ahimelec chi', ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová yuj winhaj David chi', ix ak'ji swael winh yuj winh. Ix yak'anpax k'een yespada winhaj Goliat winh filisteo winh t'a winh, xchi winhaj Doeg chi'.

Yuj chi' ix schekan winh rey chi' awtaj winhaj sakerdote Ahimelec chi' yet' masanil heb' winh sakerdote ay t'a Nob chi', haton heb' winh sk'ab' yokto sb'a yet' winhaj Ahimelec chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh smasanil t'a yichanh winh rey chi',
ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Ahimelec chi': --Ach yuninal winhaj Ahitob, ab' tas ol wala', xchi winh. --Ayinek' t'a yol a k'ab' mamin rey, xchi winhaj Ahimelec chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Saúl chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ayach och ajk'olal t'ayin yet' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi'? Ix ak' swael winh, ix ak'anpax jun k'een espada t'a winh, ix a k'anb'an t'a Dios yuj winh, yik tz'och winh ajk'olal t'ayin yik tzin smilani, ichaton sk'ulej winh tiknaik, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Ahimelec chi' t'a winh rey chi': --Mamin rey, ¿mach junok t'a skal heb' a chekab' sk'anab'ajej wal icha winhaj David, hanhejtona' to a nhi' pax winh, yajal pax yaj winh t'a skal heb' a tanhwumal, te niwan pax yelk'och winh t'a a palakio?

¿Tokwal b'ab'elto tzin k'anb'ej t'a Dios yuj winh? Mamin rey, malaj b'aj tzin och ajk'olal t'ayach, yuj chi' mokab'a tas tza na' t'a in patik yet' t'a spatik heb' in k'ab' wok, yujto manh wojtakok jab'ok tas yaj jun lolonel tik, xchi winh.
Palta t'a yelk'olal ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Anhejto tzak'och t'a a k'ool to ol ach cham yet' masanil heb' a k'ab' ok tik, xchi winh.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix schekan heb' stanhwumal winh rey chi', ix yalan winh: --Milekcham masanil heb' winh sakerdote yik Jehová tik, yujto ayoch heb' winh yet' winhaj David chi'. Yojtak heb' winh to tz'el winh elelal t'ayin, palta maj yal-laj heb' winh wab'i, xchi winh. Palta a heb' soldado stanhwumal winh rey chi', maj yal-laj sk'ol heb' ix smilcham heb' winh sakerdote yik Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Doeg chi': --Milcham heb' winh a ach tik, xchi winh. Ix och ijan winhaj Doeg chi' smilancham heb' winh sakerdote chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', 85 heb' winak tz'ak'anoch k'apak chaleka nab'a lino ix smilcham winhaj Doeg chi'.

T'a elanhchamel, ix ochpax winh t'a yol chonhab' Nob, haton schonhab' heb' winh sakerdote chi', a yet' k'een espada ix smilcham masanil heb' winak winh, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' hato yalji. Ix smilpaxcham nok' wakax winh, nok' b'uru yet' nok' kalnel.
Palta ay jun winh yuninal winhaj Ahimelec, skuchan Abiatar, ix yak' ganar winh yel lemnaj b'aj wan yoch chamel chi', ix b'atkan winh b'aj ayek' winhaj David.
A' winh ix halan t'a winhaj David chi' to a masanil heb' winh sakerdote yik Jehová, toxo ix miljicham heb' winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Saúl.

Ix yalan winhaj David chi': --Ha jun chi' wojtaktaxoni, yujto ha t'a yik chi' ix wila'' to ayek' winhaj Doeg ta', yuj chi' ix in na'a to a winh ol halan t'a winhaj Saúl chi'. Ha tiknaik, wuuj ix cham masanil heb' a k'ab' ok chi',
palta jun, kananh wet' t'a tik. Manh ach xiwok, yujto a winh ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'ayach, aypaxoch winh ajk'olal t'ayin, palta wach' aj wet' t'a tik, xchi winh.
